name: Xu xoa
summary: Xu xoa is a set seaweed jelly made from rau câu gathered around Lý Sơn, dressed with palm sugar, ginger, and coconut milk or a plain sugar syrup. It is cool, soft, and gently sweet, with a light smell of the sea.
taste: Vietnam Airlines calls it cool, mildly sea-scented, and gently sweet. ZaloPay calls it soft and chewy, pale brown, with a light sea smell.
howToEat: Vietnam Airlines: rau câu chân vịt from around Lý Sơn, cooked, set, and cut, then dressed with palm sugar cooked with ginger and coconut milk. Sold in a plastic box or a vacuum pack.
ZaloPay: a natural seaweed jelly, eaten with reduced sugar syrup and a little coconut milk, sometimes with ice.
The culture office lists xu xoa among the snacks at the Don An Phú festival.
where: The seaweed comes from around Lý Sơn.
priceBand: 30,000 VND for a 500 g box (Vietnam Airlines).
seoTitle: Xu xoa — seaweed jelly in Quang Ngai
seoDescription: Xu xoa, a cool seaweed jelly from Lý Sơn rau câu with palm sugar, ginger, and coconut milk. 30,000 VND for 500 g.
